messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I need to swap tonight's primary. Flight got bumped, arriving late. Can anyone cover 22:00-04:00 UTC? I can shadow until 21:30 and do a handoff doc.
priya: I can take primary tonight but only until 02:00 UTC. After that I have a hard meeting. Happy to take the busier chunk 22:00-02:00.
luca: I can pick up 02:00-06:00 if that helps — would prefer an overlap for runbook sync ~01:45.
maya: Thanks both. That covers it if we chain: priya primary 22:00-02:00, luca 02:00-06:00. I'll set myself as shadow until 21:45 then hand off.
eve: Reassign in PagerDuty? If we don't update the schedule the old oncall will still get pages.
maya: Good catch. I'm dropping a manual override in PD now. @pager-duty-bot can you assign primary->priya at 22:00 UTC and then priya->luca at 02:00? Also add maya as shadow until 21:45.
pager-duty-bot: Received schedule change request. To confirm: create temporary overrides: primary=priya @ 2026-03-15T22:00Z, primary=luca @ 2026-03-16T02:00Z, shadow=maya until 2026-03-15T21:45Z. Reply with "confirm" to apply.
maya: confirm
pager-duty-bot: Overrides applied. Notifications will route to the new primary as of the specified times.
ops-bot: FYI — we had a latency spike on embeds last week during the 23:30-00:15 UTC window (customer impact: increased 500s for embed ingestion). Runbook section "embeds: high 5xx" might be useful for priya. Link: https://playbook.internal/runbooks/embeds-high-5xx
priya: Thanks. Could you paste the quick triage steps here? Running through a runbook page mid-page is a pain.
ops-bot: Sure — excerpt below. Keep in mind tokens and qps changes.
```
1) Check service health: curl -sS https://metrics.internal/redwood/embeds | jq '.errors_5xx | .last_5m'
2) If errors_5xx > 5: scale up embed workers: kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embed-workers --replicas=6
3) If error pattern is 429/503 from model infra, toggle fallback route: rdxctl routing set-policy embed-route fallback:small-quantized
4) Notify infra and set pager to P2 if more than 10% of customers impacted
```
maya: Also add these shortcuts for handoff:
- Slack thread: #eng-oncall for live pager chatter
- Runbook quick links: https://playbook.internal/oncall-shortcuts
- Check dashboard filter: region=eu, model=embed-variant-v2, window=last_15m
priya: I'll take a screenshot of the dashboard at 21:50 and post it in this thread. luca, can you be ready to accept an escalation handoff at 01:45 for a brief overlap?
luca: Yep, I'll be on and available. Planning to be online 01:30-02:15 to get context.
eve: Small ops note — if you modify PD overrides, make sure the calendar event in Google Calendar is updated so SRE knows who to ping for postmortem.
maya: I'll update the calendar and add the runbook link. priya — when you take over, please run the following sanity checks within 5 minutes:
```
# sanity checks
1) rdxctl health check embeds --window 5m
2) curl -sS https://ingest.internal/health | grep OK
3) kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embed-workers -o wide
```
priya: Acknowledged. I'll also set a quick alert for elevated 5xx threshold for the first hour of my shift.
ops-bot: Reminder: If customer impact > 2% escalate to P1 and call the incident bridge. Bridge link: https://meet.internal/incident-bridge
maya: One more: if you end up toggling fallback route, ping infra channel and tag @oncall-infra. We want a quick rollback plan if perf drops.
priya: Got it. I'll post a short handoff note at 21:55 with dashboard screenshot. Thanks all.
luca: Thanks — see you in the handover.
maya: Appreciate the coverage. Marking thread resolved once calendar + PD + shadow are set.
ops-bot: Thread annotation: coverage chain set (maya->priya->luca). No active incidents.
